items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I love it. You say his name was Pecking Joe Steele. The nickname, Pecking -- >> [INTERVIEWEE] Joe.

ctx.x: I love it. You say his name was Pecking Joe Steele. The nickname, Pecking --
Yes, is it anything to do with, like, wood pecker, pecking? I know you use your heels so much, you know, he uses his heels -- or did use his heels.
